exercise1.prompt: Files write missing values in a dozen ways; na_values names yours.

hiddenCases.name: a file with nothing missing counts them all

exercise1.hint: Name "n/a" in na_values so it loads as missing, then count what is left with notna().sum() or by dropping the missing rows.

questions.prompt: Which of these does pandas treat as missing without being told?
questions.explain: An empty field and a few spellings of NA are recognised. Anything your particular source invented has to be named in na_values.

questions.prompt: What does one unrecognised "n/a" do to a numeric column?
questions.explain: The column has to hold one type, and the only type that fits both numbers and "n/a" is text. Every calculation after that is affected.
notna is a mask of "has a value", and summing a mask counts the True entries.
